question.nlq: Hey! Could you help me pull up the drivers and constructors who raced in Monaco? I'd love to get their names and the season year they were in.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The clause 'who raced in Monaco' attaches only to the nearest noun, i.e., it applies solely to constructors and not to drivers.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT name, year FROM (
    SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS name, r.year
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.name AS name, r.year
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN constructors AS c ON res.constructorId = c.constructorId
    JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN circuits AS ci ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId
    WHERE ci.name LIKE '%Monaco%'
) ORDER BY name, year;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The clause 'who raced in Monaco' attaches to the whole conjunction, so it applies to both drivers and constructors.

SELECT DISTINCT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
                con.name AS constructor_name,

JOIN circuits AS ci ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId
JOIN drivers AS d ON rs.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors AS con ON rs.constructorId = con.constructorId
WHERE ci.name = 'Circuit de Monaco';

question.nlq: I would like to obtain the names and nationalities of the Drivers and Constructors who possess British nationality and have recorded more than 10 race wins in their career, sorted by their lifetime total points in descending order.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The conditions regarding British nationality and the minimum of 10 race wins apply exclusively to Constructors. Drivers are included in the list without restriction on nationality or win count.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT 
    name,
    nationality,
    total_points
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS name,
        d.nationality,
        SUM(ds.points) AS total_points,
        0 AS total_wins,
        'driver' AS entity_type
    FROM drivers d
    INNER JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
    GROUP BY d.driverId
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        c.name AS name,
        c.nationality,
        SUM(cs.points) AS total_points,
        SUM(cs.wins) AS total_wins,
        'constructor' AS entity_type
    FROM constructors c
    INNER JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
    GROUP BY c.constructorId
    HAVING c.nationality = 'British' AND SUM(cs.wins) > 10
)
ORDER BY total_points DESC

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The conditions regarding British nationality and the minimum of 10 race wins apply to both Drivers and Constructors. Both groups must meet these criteria to be included in the list.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT name, nationality FROM (
    SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS name,
           d.nationality,
           SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
    GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
    HAVING SUM(ds.wins) > 10
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT c.name,
           c.nationality,
           SUM(cs.points) AS total_points
    FROM constructors c
    JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'British'
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
    HAVING SUM(cs.wins) > 10
)
ORDER BY total_points DESC

turns.sql:
WITH driver_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS name,
        d.nationality,
        COALESCE(SUM(r.points),0) AS total_points
    FROM drivers d
    LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
),
constructor_stats AS (
    SELECT
        c.constructorId,
        c.name,
        c.nationality,
        COALESCE(SUM(cr.points),0) AS total_points,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_wins
    FROM constructors c
    LEFT JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
    LEFT JOIN results r ON c.constructorId = r.constructorId
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
)
SELECT name, nationality FROM (
    SELECT name, nationality, total_points FROM driver_stats
    UNION ALL
    SELECT name, nationality, total_points FROM constructor_stats
    WHERE nationality = 'British' AND total_wins > 10
) ORDER BY total_points DESC;

  SELECT d.driverId,
         d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS name,
         d.nationality,
         SUM(ds.points) AS total_points,
         SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
  WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
  GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
  HAVING SUM(ds.wins) > 10
),
constructor_stats AS (
  SELECT c.constructorId,
         c.name AS name,
         c.nationality,
         SUM(cs.points) AS total_points,
         SUM(cs.wins) AS total_wins
  FROM constructors c

  WHERE c.nationality = 'British'
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
  HAVING SUM(cs.wins) > 10
)
SELECT name, nationality
FROM (

  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, nationality, total_points FROM constructor_stats
) combined
ORDER BY total_points DESC;
